title: Ilocos minimum wage workers to get P35-40 pay hike by Dec. 14

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Minimum wage earners in the Ilocos region will receive a daily wage increase of P35 to P40 starting Dec. 14, while domestic workers will also get a P450 monthly pay increase. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino announced the new wage adjustments on Wednesday, Nov. 25, following the approval of the wage orders by the National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC). Under Wage Order No. I-25, workers in non-agricultural establishments employing at least 10 employees will receive a P40 increase, raising their daily minimum wage from P505 to P545.
